fact: The Prime Minister's Decree n° 22/07 of 2 March 2022 creates the Fichier Général de la Population (FGP), run by ONIP, with a national identification number and biometric data, as a decree alone; its legal bases cite no identity law, only the 2011 decree setting up ONIP and a 1923 decree-law requiring residents to be recorded.
system: Fichier Général de la Population (FGP), Décret n° 22/07 du 2 mars 2022

fact: Two national deputies tabled at the National Assembly's Bureau a private member's bill (proposition de loi) on the general rules for identifying natural persons in the DRC, which the document says is to go through committee and then possibly plenary, with the existing identity arrangements resting on decrees creating the Fichier Général de la Population and the national identity card.
system: Proposition de loi portant règles générales applicables à l'identification des personnes physiques
